info.title: SocialClaw API
info.description: Complete SocialClaw API reference for social account connections, media uploads, validation, scheduling, publishing, analytics, dashboard APIs, webhooks, and delivery URLs.

get.description:
Returns service, database, storage, worker, billing, and public URL health.

Note: Use this route for uptime checks. It does not require a workspace or API key.

Note: The response includes deployment configuration, not tenant-specific account health.

post.description:
Starts a provider connection. OAuth providers return an authorize URL; Telegram and Discord create manual connections.

Note: Supported providers: x, facebook, instagram_business, instagram, threads (when enabled), snapchat, tiktok, linkedin, linkedin_page, pinterest, youtube, reddit, discord, telegram, wordpress.

Note: For Telegram, include botToken and chatId. For Discord, include webhookUrl.

post.description:
Downloads an image or video from a public URL into the media library. Returns 201 with a ready asset when the import finishes within about 40 seconds, otherwise 202 with status uploading while it continues in the background.

Note: On 202, poll GET /v1/assets/{assetId} until status is ready before using publicUrl as media_link. A failed import reports status failed with an error message.

Note: Files up to 1 GB. The URL must be a direct link to the file, not a web page.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned by JSON API routes.

ApiKey.description: API key metadata. Secret values are only returned when a key is created or shown in the dashboard key API.

id.description: API key id, for example key_abc123.

prefix.description: Public prefix used to identify the key without exposing the secret.

kind.description: Key kind, such as personal or agent.

secret.description: Raw key secret. Only present at creation or in dashboard key listings.

Tenant.description: Workspace visible to the authenticated API key or dashboard session.

ConnectedAccount.description: Social account or destination connected to a SocialClaw workspace.

handle.description: Stable account handle used in schedules.

ConnectionStartRequest.description: Request to start an OAuth or manual connection. Telegram and Discord use manual credentials; other providers return an OAuth URL.

botToken.description: Telegram bot token. Also accepted as bot_token.

chatId.description: Telegram chat id. Also accepted as chat_id.

webhookUrl.description: Discord webhook URL. Also accepted as webhook_url.

client.description: Optional client hint, for example ios.

callbackScheme.description: Optional mobile callback scheme. Also accepted as callback_scheme.

status.description: pending, connected, failed, or provider-specific state.

authorizeUrl.description: OAuth authorize URL when OAuth is required.

Capability.description: Publishing capabilities for a connected account or provider.

canPublish.description: Whether SocialClaw can publish to this account.

PublishSettings.description: Provider-specific publish settings. Returned fields are authoritative for UI generation.

supported.description: Whether settings are available for this account.

discovery.description: Provider media delivery and publish-shape notes.

DiscoveryAction.description: Provider discovery action such as syncing boards, pages, or channels.

inputSchema.description: Optional JSON Schema for action input.

AssetInput.description: Media asset referenced by a post.

managed.description: True when this is a SocialClaw-managed asset.

altText.description: Alt text where the provider supports it.

PostInput.description: Post to validate, schedule, or publish.

provider.description: Provider. Optional when account handle identifies the provider.

name.description: Post title, campaign step title, or provider title.

title.description: Alias for name on providers requiring titles.

assets.description: One or more asset objects or URL strings.

settings.description: Provider-specific settings from the publish settings API. Standalone Instagram supports destination/format plus per-media alt text and people tags, collaborators, Reel cover/thumbnail/feed/audio/Trial controls, AI disclosure, and location IDs. post_and_story requires one asset and creates two independent jobs.

parent_step_id.description: Parent step id for reply/thread workflows.

CampaignInput.description: Campaign graph with targets and steps.

ScheduleEnvelope.description: Schedule document accepted by validation, preview, apply, and dashboard compose workflows.

mode.description: scheduled creates runnable posts; draft creates an editable draft run.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key. Also accepted as idempotency_key.

schedule.description: Optional wrapper. Routes accept either the envelope directly or { schedule: envelope }.

totalPosts.description: Number of posts in the run.

status.description: ready, uploading, draft, pending_delete, or provider-specific state.

AssetUploadRequest.description: Base64 upload request for small media files.

mime.description: MIME type. Inferred from filename when omitted.

AssetImportRequest.description: Imports media from a public URL. The server streams the file straight into storage.

sourceUrl.description: Direct public http(s) URL of the image or video file.

filename.description: Optional file name with extension. Inferred from the URL or Content-Type when omitted.

AssetRegistrationRequest.description: Registers an already-stored asset or externally managed object for the workspace.

originalFilename.description: Original filename. Also accepted as filename.

MultipartUploadInitiateRequest.description: Starts a multipart upload session for dashboard uploads when S3 storage is enabled.

filename.description: File name. Also accepted as name.

uploadId.description: Multipart upload id returned by initiate.

MultipartCompleteRequest.description: Completes a multipart upload after the client sends every signed part.

parts.description: Uploaded parts with ETag and partNumber.

AnalyticsRefreshRequest.description: Requests a fresh analytics fetch for a published post.

postId.description: Post id. Also accepted as post_id.

SupportRequest.description: Support message submitted from the website or dashboard.

email.description: Reply-to email when no dashboard session exists.

DashboardComposeRequest.description: Dashboard compose request. Supports one account or a targets array.

title.description: Post title. Also accepted as name.

text.description: Post body. Also accepted as description.

DashboardPostUpdateRequest.description: Updates an editable dashboard timeline post.

BillingCancellationIntentRequest.description: Captures optional cancellation feedback before a dashboard billing admin continues in Lemon Squeezy.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason id. Unknown values are accepted but are not classified.

detail.description: Optional free-form feedback, truncated to 2,000 characters.

AppStoreClaimRequest.description: Claims an App Store transaction for the current dashboard workspace.

signedTransactionInfo.description: App Store signed transaction JWS. Also accepted as signed_transaction_info or transactionJws.

AppleNativeAuthRequest.description: Native iOS Sign in with Apple identity token exchange.

identityToken.description: Apple identity token. Also accepted as identity_token.

nonceSha256.description: SHA-256 nonce. Also accepted as nonce.

email.description: Email supplied by Apple on first sign-in.

EmailAuthConfigResponse.description: Authentication methods available to the web sign-in experience.

email.description: Whether email and password authentication is enabled.

EmailSignUpRequest.description: Starts email account creation and sends a verification link.

password.description: Password. The configured length limits apply.

next.description: Safe relative path to open after verification.

EmailSignInRequest.description: Signs in with a verified email credential.

next.description: Safe relative path to open after sign-in.

EmailTokenRequest.description: Consumes a single-use email authentication token.

next.description: Safe relative path to open after verification.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Requests account recovery without disclosing whether the address is registered.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Replaces an email credential using a single-use reset token.

password.description: New password. The configured length limits apply.

redirectTo.description: Safe relative path to open after success.

debugUrl.description: Local-development email link. Never returned in production.

ok.description: Always true for successful JSON API responses.

secret.description: Raw secret when returned as a top-level value.

AnalyticsResponse.description: Analytics response. `latest` is the most recent snapshot (post/account scope); `snapshot` is the one just written by a refresh. Each snapshot has `status` ("ready" when metrics were fetched, "unsupported" when the provider has no public post-metrics API or the post could not be resolved), `supported`, an optional `message`, and a `metrics` object with impressions, reach, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, and clicks (fields the provider does not return are null).

latest.description: Most recent stored snapshot for this scope, or null.

snapshot.description: The snapshot written by a refresh call.

duplicate.description: True when idempotency reused an existing run.

mode.description: multipart when S3 upload is used, otherwise base64.

enabled.description: Whether App Store billing is enabled.
